stories.text: ⚡ Early edge: 49er Faith-Fool went from 19% to 46% against Claremont In Yo Stace!, led by Dobbins (13.60 pts).
😅 TDsMaGee is sweating out a close one with Mr. Action Jackson (47% to win). Starting RJ Harvey (14.60 pts) over Emanuel Wilson (5.20 pts) would have helped.
🗑️ DROP REGRET: Drake Maye averaged 7.5 before 49er Faith-Fool cut him in Week 4. Since: 33.3 a week. Now he's helping Brock You Like a Hurricane.
🏟️ Game to watch: ARI @ LAR (Sunday 4:05 PM), 9 league starters in action with 139.36 pts up for grabs. It could swing TDsMaGee vs Mr. Action Jackson by 35%.
📺 Up next, Sunday 9:30 AM (HOU VS JAX): 9 league starters in action. Most riding on it: Ramosverse vs Kirbo Crushers (35.61 pts projected).
🗓️ Sunday's key matchup: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy 51% vs Ruffing the Passer. Watch Young (18.52 pts) vs Love (21.40 pts).
🕰️ Coulda-shoulda swap: If TDsMaGee and Claremont In Yo Stace! had swapped Wilson for Skattebo and Andrews back in Week 1, both would be ahead (+2 wins each).
🗓️ Another tight one Sunday: Mr. Action Jackson 53% vs TDsMaGee. TDsMaGee leads by 5.20 after TNF. Watch Nacua (23.23 pts) vs Williams (21.30 pts).
🏈 6 matchups are still up for grabs, and Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy vs Ruffing the Passer (Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy 51%) is the tightest.
📈 TRENDING: Tanner McKee (QB, PHI) is one of the most-added players in fantasy over the past 24 hours. Nobody here has him.
👀 League gossip: Kyle Tucker has 37.40 pts to play with against Gibb it to Me Baby.
📈 Stock rising: Kyle Tucker has its ESPN projection trending up.
📈 49er Faith-Fool was down to 16% against The Mahomies — and won.
